{{Quote|It will be like swatting flies.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]|<ref name="Death Star (novel)">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
'''Flies''' were a classification of [[Insect/Legends|insect]]. They came in all forms around the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], including [[Bahl fly|Bahl flies]],<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Blood fly|blood flies]],<ref name="CE">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire]]''</ref> and [[Firefly/Legends|fireflies]].<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>
